conditional_material_method.basis: Reuse the qualified conditional SAE J429_201405 Grade 5 minimum tensile yield of 92 ksi for the 1/4–1-inch size band, explicitly linked to ASTM F606/F606M-21 and the NDS 2024 §12.3.6.2 tensile-yield route. No proof/Fu average or universal physical Fy=Fyb identity is used.
conditional_material_method.supplier_or_product_gap: The Type is a design and receiving specification, not a selected supplier SKU. A generic Grade 5, 6.5-inch, partial-thread label does not establish the exact HCS body, grip, length and style requirements. No saved listing establishes every condition.

current_geometry_head_feasibility.transfer_reason: All twelve proposed head datums and unchanged hardware records match the saved old screen. The four shortened shafts are contained in prior occupancy and four removals reduce obstacles; only the four translated nuts needed new separation checks. No CAD edits or native runs were used.

old_held_force_only_strength_comparison.interpretation: The bound includes the smaller 2A root, later transition and all saved forces and moments. It supports review feasibility; it is not a new candidate capacity or clearance result.
old_held_force_only_strength_comparison.scope: These completed 144-state comparisons belong to the old relocated 114-bolt geometry 9bab57ac… and bank ef84f0a7…. They are neither the new zero-spacer bank nor a matched twelve-head alternate. Use them only to assess whether this hardware option merits evaluation.

operation.fixed: All 114 physical bolt axes, centers, directions, nominal diameters, holes, eight-bolt corner counts, wood and plywood profiles, 24 fittings, 66 screw axes, washer seats, nut seats and nominal 165.1 mm underhead/tip stations remain fixed.
operation.head_change_required: Replace each socket head with a compliant hex head at the same underhead bearing face. Reusing the four-post Type specification does not preserve these 12 socket heads or transfer the four-post operation that retained its existing hex heads.
operation.replace: Twelve 3/8-16 × 6.5-inch A574 socket-cap fasteners become conforming 3/8-16 × 6.5-inch SAE J429_201405 Grade 5 full-body, partially threaded hex cap screws to ASME B18.2.1-2012, default Style 1.

precise_dimensional_changes_mm.thread_rule: Per-member quarter-thread wood screen is conditionally met; thread roots remain in the detailed strength calculation and steel flange. This does not guarantee delivered root/runout or calibrated physical thread stiffness.

purpose: Replace the 12 existing 6.5-inch A574 cleat bolts with the same conditional Grade 5 Style 1 type used by the four zero-spacer cleat-post stacks. This presents a concrete material specification for review without moving bolts or redesigning wood.
required_if_owner_selects_Grade5_option: Create separate hardware geometry and metadata with 12 compliant hex heads and updated body, root and grip source contracts. Preserve all fixed bolt lines and wood, washer and nut stations.

Recheck simultaneous maximum heads and fillets, flat head/washer bearing, actual washer thickness, hole-entry seating, tool engagement and assembly/removal access. A bounding-cylinder clearance is not delivered fit.

Bind the exact conditional Type and material specification or a conforming supplier product. Preserve blank Actual/Disposition fields; do not assume supplier guarantees for class, root, runout or length.

Run a fresh matched six-case bank, replays and component references for the adopted head, profile and mass configuration. Neither the old 144-state comparison nor the current four-stack zero-spacer bank qualifies the twelve-head alternate.
Keep unresolved geometry, row/group, splitting, fitting, screw/panel, bond, support and complete-joint checks separate. The same diameter and positions provide no new spacing credit.

separate_A574_procurement_alternative.description: Keep the current socket-head form and profile, but expressly require conventional 0.2%-offset minimum tensile yield of at least 60 ksi under the applicable F606/F606M-21 procedure, and conservatively choose Fyb=60 ksi. Generic A574 or SKU 8093 alone does not establish this extra condition.
